conventions.layerName: Paper layer name is canonical. Variants use a dot suffix (OBSetRow.done). A block may map to a shared widget or an inline composition; the Dart owner need not match the Paper name.
conventions.canonical: The node on the Bausteine page is canonical. Screens contain clones; a visual change is made on the Bausteine node first, then re-applied to the widget, then screens are re-derived.
conventions.package: Existing ui2 code is reused — not every Paper block is a class in lib/openband. implementationStatus is explicit when the block is not in source; absent status means implemented when file and widget resolve.
conventions.honesty: Absent input renders as — or is omitted. Partial totals are labeled; no ≥ prefix or invented length for unknown amounts. Progress requires an actual saved target.
conventions.sourceCheck: tool/check_design_manifest.py verifies that implemented file/widget references exist in source. It does not verify routing or visual acceptance.

blocks.name: OBJournalTagsRow

blocks.name: OBNutritionGoalNumber
blocks.notes: Canonical amount field with baseline-aligned unit; blank stays unset, finite decimal boundary, no internal whitespace repair. Full-width at narrow/large text.

blocks.name: OBNutritionGoalMacros
blocks.notes: One grams/percent editor, lossless canonical gram values across view switches. Explicit energy edits rescale only percent mode; invalid totals refuse save.

blocks.name: OBNutritionGoalsOverview
blocks.notes: Optional actual stored targets with dated/undated origin. No recommended/default value. Actions lead to same editor/history.

blocks.name: OBNutritionTargetHistory
blocks.notes: Actual dated boundaries, including empty removal boundaries and future planned changes. No synthetic historical origin for undated preferences.

blocks.name: OBFoodEntrySummary
blocks.notes: Stored energy and macros only; unknown values remain absent. Three columns at normal width, aligned label/value rows at large text or small width.

blocks.name: OBFoodEntryEditor
blocks.notes: One retained draft for name, meal, date, quantity, consumed time, note and all ten nutrients. CAS conflicts require explicit reload; no source conversion.

blocks.name: OBFoodNutrientEditor
blocks.notes: Shared nutrient row preserves zero, unknowns and stored precision. Photo values require explicit confirmation before final save.

blocks.name: OBFoodQuantitySheet
blocks.notes: Quantity and unit are explicit. Nutrient scaling is opt-in and requires a known positive original quantity and unchanged unit.

blocks.name: OBFoodEditSheet
blocks.notes: Shared bounded sheet frame for quantity and time; pinned header/action, scrolling body and keyboard clearance. Missing time has no default.

blocks.name: OBMealDraftSheet
blocks.notes: Retained draft commit and append use atomic CAS. Pending additions merge over latest base without resurrecting concurrent removals. Failure retains intent and retry until explicit cancellation; committed reload is read-only.

blocks.name: OBFoodUndo
blocks.notes: Exact deleted snapshot belongs to its repository/day/operation. Successful restore and failed subsequent read have separate retries. At large text the message precedes a wrapping action row.

blocks.name: OBNutritionWeek
blocks.notes: Saved seven-day window only; empty, unknown energy, stored zero and partial totals remain distinct. Positive bars use actual recorded energy ratios.

blocks.name: OBRecentFoods
blocks.notes: Deduplicated stored foods; reuse creates a new entry identity and clears consumed/source-capture timestamps while retaining nutrient source.

blocks.name: OBNutritionFooter
blocks.notes: Search, barcode and add actions; 44-point tap targets, 52-point normal and 60-point large-text surface with bottom safe-area clearance. Hidden on week.

blocks.name: OBMealPickerSheet
blocks.notes: No guessed meal selection. Four choices, contiguous 48-point rows and scrolling when text/height requires it.

blocks.name: OBWaterCard
blocks.notes: Stored journal water value; unknown is not zero. Atomic delta, explicit manual amount, removal and conflict reload. Read failure after successful save retries only the read.

blocks.name: OBFoodFeedback.pending
blocks.notes: Persistent failed intent with retry/cancel, immutable original day and operation identity. No silent expiry or duplicate append.

implementedHubs: Laufen · aktiv (UI over LiveRun; host feeds GPS/HR)
Einrichtung · Willkommen / Band verbinden / Erste Übertragung / Dein Profil (ui2/onboarding)
status.hostWiring: app.dart: four tabs use the OpenBand hubs; Laufen tile → OpenBandRunLive over AppState (single live engine, _LiveRunFeed); templates → OpenBandStrengthLive via startStrengthSession(AppState.startWorkout); meals → OBFoodSearchSheet → showOpenBandMealDraft. Live route map (flutter_map, CARTO tiles) renders only with mapTilesAllowed; laps are recorded via recordLap and frozen into the session snapshot.

nightSignals.decision: Alpin 3 remains the visual contract. Borrow compact metric context and clear trace hierarchy. Keep stored HRV uncertainty and refuse to connect samples across unsupported timing gaps.
